name: ninicakes
description: Nini Cakes - Storefront + Admin + API (Node/Express/TS, React/Vite/TS, MySQL8/Prisma)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,customer,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w customer-web run dev" "npm -w admin-web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w server run build && npm -w customer-web run build && npm -w admin-web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run build && npm -w customer-web run typecheck && npm -w admin-web run typecheck
